title: IneqAgent: Agentic Inequality Proving in Lean with Symbolic Computation
abstract: arXiv:2610.20681v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Formal inequality proving requires mathematical reasoning and exact computation, often connected through intermediate lemmas and goal reformulations. We introduce IneqAgent, an agentic framework combining LLM reasoning with symbolic computation for inequality proving in Lean4. Lemma-level Monte Carlo Tree Search coordinates lemma construction, goal reformulation, and symbolic backend selection. Complementary sum-of-squares, Bernstein, and successive difference-substitution backends produce exact certificates for local Lean proof generation. The agent integrates these proofs with LLM-generated steps and uses Lean feedback to construct complete proofs checked against the original theorem statements. On four benchmarks, IneqAgent with DeepSeek-V4-Flash solves 175 of 186 problems (94.09%), achieving the highest overall success rate among the evaluated methods. Across four backbones, it achieves higher success rates at low LLM inference cost

translated_title: IneqAgent：基于符号计算的Lean智能体不等式证明
translated_abstract: 形式化不等式证明需要数学推理与精确计算，二者通常通过中间引理和目标重构相互关联。我们提出IneqAgent，一个将大语言模型（LLM）推理与符号计算相结合、用于Lean4不等式证明的智能体框架。引理级蒙特卡洛树搜索负责协调引理构造、目标重构与符号后端的选择。互补的平方和、Bernstein以及逐次差代换后端可为局部Lean证明的生成提供精确证书。该智能体将这些证明与LLM生成的步骤相整合，并利用Lean反馈构建出可对照原始定理陈述进行验证的完整证明。在四个基准测试上，配备DeepSeek-V4-Flash的IneqAgent解决了186个问题中的175个（94.09%），在所评估的方法中取得了最高的总体成功率。在四种骨干模型上，它均以较低的LLM推理成本实现了更高的成功率。
tldr: IneqAgent通过引理级蒙特卡洛树搜索协调LLM推理与平方和、Bernstein、差代换等符号计算后端，在Lean4中实现了形式化不等式证明，在四个基准测试上以94.09%的解题率取得最高成功率。
en_tdlr: IneqAgent coordinates LLM reasoning with symbolic computation backends (sum-of-squares, Bernstein, difference-substitution) via lemma-level Monte Carlo Tree Search to achieve agentic inequality proving in Lean4, solving 94.09% of problems across four benchmarks.
